prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, late 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, sculpted updo ash brown hair — full body golden bocote wood carved directly over her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid carved wood curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted carved sections whose grain changes direction from one section to the next, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own soft glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING golden bocote grain across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID dark brown swirling lines running between the carved sections, with a carved geometric lattice relief across every section, polished to a warm satin sheen, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Pose: one hand lightly holding the opposite wrist low in front of her hips, standing tall with her chin lifted — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Cracks: the golden bocote wood body shows weathering in only three places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her right upper arm, and two chipped-off pieces, one at her right calf and one at her left forearm, where the broken edge reveals the pale raw fresh wood with a rough splintered grain, much lighter than the dark polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the golden bocote wood is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto pumps in nude leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, while her body keeps its full original proportions — thick heavy thighs, wide full hips and a huge bust exactly as massive as before, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved golden bocote wood right down to the shoes.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, carved from the same bocote wood with a high polish.
Jewelry: heavy gold rings on every finger, a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face, ears and entire neck are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips. Her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved golden bocote wood.

Background: a sunlit white-washed courtyard with a pale tiled floor, an arched doorway at normal height, low stone steps and a tall olive tree, bright midday light, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — carved material everywhere from the collarbones to the ankles. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
